Name: CS_VOLUMETRIC_EFFECT_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Volumetric fog settings for each level of the Volumetric Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 2.

Fields.Name: Volumetric Fog Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns volumetric fog on for this level. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Fog Shadow Enabled
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Fog Shadow Sample Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the fog shadow sample count; the result is clamped to 1–32. Retail: -2 up to Medium, 0 High, 2 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Fog Local Light Distance Scale
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the distance over which local lights light the fog; 0 leaves local lights out of the fog. Retail: 0 Off, 1 otherwise.

Fields.Name: Fog Grid Size Multiplier
Fields.Description: Fog grid width and height = base size × Multiplier ÷ Divider, at least 16. Retail: Low 5/8, Medium 3/4, High 1/1, Maximum 3/2.

Fields.Name: Fog Grid Size Divider
Fields.Description: Divides the fog grid width and height (see Fog Grid Size Multiplier).

Fields.Name: Fog Depth Slice Multiplier
Fields.Description: Number of fog depth slices = base count × Multiplier ÷ Divider, at least 4. Retail: Low 2/3, Medium 5/6, High 1/1, Maximum 3/2.

Fields.Name: Fog Depth Slice Divider
Fields.Description: Divides the number of fog depth slices (see Fog Depth Slice Multiplier).

Fields.Name: Placed Fog Volumes Enabled
Fields.Description: Enables the fog volumes placed in maps, where the scene allows them. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Upscale Type
Fields.Description: Upscale method of placed fog volumes. 2 selects the alternative method; 0 and 1 behave the same. Retail: 2 Off, 1 Low to High, 0 Maximum.

Fields.Name: Edge Correction Level
Fields.Description: Edge redraw level used with bilateral upscaling: 0 off, 1 half-resolution edges, 2 half- and full-resolution edges with reduced parameters, 3 half- and full-resolution edges. Retail: 0 Off and Low, 2 Medium, 3 High and Maximum.

Fields.Name: Extra Ray March Samples
Fields.Description: Only zero versus non-zero matters: any non-zero value turns on the extra ray-marching samples. Retail: 32 on Maximum, 0 otherwise.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Shadows Enabled
Fields.Description: Allows shadows and density shading in placed fog volumes. Retail: off only on the Off row.

Fields.Name: Force Fog Volume Shadows
Fields.Description: On: shadows are always cast into fog volumes when fog volume shadows are allowed, whatever the volume's own setting. Retail: off on every row.

Fields.Name: Fog Volume Resolution
Fields.Description: Resolution step of the fog volume upscale, 0–2. Retail: 2, 1 on Maximum.
